negative_observations: MngA overexpression-dependent MG toxicity does not establish normal physiological MG toxicity.
No MG-mediated porin reporter effect observed in the tested2004 conditions; no new OmpF/OmpC causaledge.
Trehalose-deficientKM522 saltprotection experiment was negative; no generic osmoprotection edge.
Mannose did not induce MGtransport in tested wildtype; this does not validate MG-P directMngRbinding.
2013R465A reduces alphaKGbinding affinity; no exactsite-specific universalnativeinhibition state asserted.
EIY122F alters localization but fructose-consumption phenotype was unaffected in the reported assay; no equivalence of localization and universalcatalytic inhibition.
